title: Link review handoff
description: A media-free archive manifest for reproducing and comparing a link-review corpus on another host.

manifest_sha256.description: Seal of this manifest, excluding this field.

expires_on.description: Last UTC calendar day on which a recipient may open this handoff.

corpus_id.description: Corpus version each host creates locally.

corpus_manifest_sha256.description: Seal of the corpus manifest used by the exporting host.

frame_set_sha256.description: Verified frame-set identity used for cross-host comparison.

links_run_id.description: Link-review run carried by the archive.

links_manifest_sha256.description: Seal of the carried link record.

base_checkpoint_sha256.description: Checkpoint identity accepted before this review branch, or null when none existed.

checkpoint_sha256.description: Checkpoint identity carried now, or null when no checkpoint exists.

files.description: Every non-manifest archive member in ascending path order.

items.description: One fixed archive member and its identity.

path.description: Safe relative POSIX path inside the archive.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact member bytes.

x-rules.seal: manifest_sha256 is SHA-256 of the record excluding that key, serialized as sorted-key JSON with ASCII escapes and no whitespace.
x-rules.files: Files are sorted by path, paths are unique and exactly match archive members other than manifest.json. Exactly one links and one staged_hashes member exist, and checkpoint presence agrees with checkpoint_sha256.
x-rules.checkpoint: base_checkpoint_sha256 identifies the imported branch point. A receiver replaces its checkpoint only when its current identity equals the base or the carried identity.
x-rules.contents: Recipes contain only operator-selected creation inputs. Source media, staged frames, feature rows and model weights are absent.
